candidates.change_summary: Changed the Deposit guard from > MinDeposit to >= MinDeposit so deposits equal to MinDeposit are accepted and update balances.
Removed the overflow check require so Deposit will add msg.value without the require protection.
Replaced the conditional body to subtract msg.value from balances (introducing an observable different balance change).
Moved the TransferLog.AddMessage call to before updating balances so the log records the event prior to balance change (observable ordering of external log contract calls may change behavior).
Deleted the conditional entirely so every call with any msg.value updates balances (including zero), changing balances for keys.
